content:
**One Star - Biggest Waste of Money Ever**

I purchased this foam mattress six months ago, and I have regretted it every single night since. Despite the description promising "medium firm" support, it feels like I'm sleeping in a bowl of pudding that swallows me whole. The chemical smell when I first unboxed it was so overpowering that I had to air it out for two full weeks before I could even stand to be in the same room. After just three months of use, a permanent body-shaped indentation formed right in the center, making it impossible to find a comfortable position. I wake up every morning drenched in sweat because this mattress traps heat like a furnace, despite the company's claims about "cooling gel technology." My back pain has gotten significantly worse since switching to this mattress, and my chiropractor confirmed it's providing almost zero spinal support. I tried to take advantage of the so-called "100-night guarantee," but customer service made the return process an absolute nightmare filled with hidden fees and endless runarounds. Save your money and avoid this overpriced slab of foam at all costs — I'm going back to a traditional spring mattress immediately.
